issue.title: FlagTriage gate preview omits the flag's call sites, so the human deciding Remove/Extend/Keep cannot see where the flag is used
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY: phase bead sase-nb.6 (2026-08-16T22:31:02Z) during epic sase-nb ('Feature flags whose removal is a bead, a deadline, and a gate'); triaged and filed by the sase-nb land agent at close.

PROBLEM: the FlagTriage gate asks the owner to choose Remove / Extend / Keep / Close for a flag whose removal deadline has passed, but its reviewed preview (src/sase/bead/_flag_gate_preview.py::render_flag_triage_preview) renders only the thresholds warning block, the definition's description, the bead description, and optional notes. It never names the code that reads the flag, so the owner answers 'should the enabled branch win?' without seeing how many branches exist or where they are.

The data already exists: src/sase/feature_flags/references.py::find_flag_call_sites locates non-test call sites for a registered flag, and 'sase flag show' already renders them (src/sase/feature_flags/cli.py:47,156,438,488). Only the gate preview is missing them.

WHY IT IS NOT A ONE-LINER (from the proposing bead): the FlagTriage contract byte-compares the rendered preview against the adapter's spec, so the preview cannot scan a mutable working tree at render time -- two renders of the same gate would disagree as soon as a commit lands. The call sites have to be captured into the gate's persisted payload when the gate is created (sase.bead.flag_gate.create_flag_triage_gate / _flag_gate_spec.build_flag_triage_gate_spec), then rendered from that frozen list, the same way every other payload-derived field is.

SCOPE: add a payload-captured call-site list to the flag triage gate spec, render it as a preview section, keep the byte-comparable preview contract and the strict spec validation in src/sase/notification_gates/kind_validation/flag_triage.py intact, and extend the existing gate tests (tests/test_bead/test_flag_gate_preview.py, test_flag_gate.py) to pin the new section. Decide what happens when the scan finds zero call sites -- that is itself a signal worth showing.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-nb — the closed epic that shipped the FlagTriage gate (phase sase-nb.6) and 'sase flag show''s call-site scan (phase sase-nb.7). The scan this task should reuse already exists; only the gate preview lacks it.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by f136f4fbd 'feat: reconcile memory, plan publication, and flag policy contracts'. The gate spec now captures call sites into its persisted payload (_flag_gate_spec.py:28,148,181,226 via flag_call_sites_payload) and the preview renders them from that frozen list (_flag_gate_preview.py:58,96,168 _flag_triage_call_sites_section) -- the payload-captured approach the bead specified to keep the byte-comparable preview contract intact. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
